purpose: Human-reviewed first S4 family batch. These decisions are applied to the persistent S4 review base and remain candidate-only until the exact coverage/freeze gate passes.

decisions.mapping_basis: Frozen S4 bytecode/address review identifies the historical Banana Gun router. Its source ABI is unverified, so the native model intentionally uses an independent conservative router-global execution-guard state class for the observed swap/fallback selectors; this is a conflict-preserving semantic abstraction, not an EVM-application-equivalence claim.
decisions.semantic_notes: Observed swap/fallback calls are mapped to the conservative route-execution guard. Unknown selectors remain explicit mapped-opaque/background behavior rather than guessed application semantics.

decisions.mapping_basis: Frozen S4 activity for this LINK runtime family is ERC20 transfer-dominated. The reviewed S4 selector scope is represented by cw20-base balance/transfer/allowance state; selectors outside that reviewed scope remain opaque.
decisions.semantic_notes: Reuse only the standard fungible-token dependency classes exercised by frozen S4.

decisions.mapping_basis: Frozen S4 activity combines standard ERC721 approval/transfer paths with selector 0x3bb1ee11, whose public transaction effects are mint-like. The native translation preserves the ERC721 ownership/approval plus sequential-mint dependency classes; exact EVM mint cardinality/cryptographic validation is outside the S4 claim.
decisions.semantic_notes: 0x3bb1ee11 is translated as one logical mint event per source call to preserve the mint-state dependency class; the workload does not claim exact EVM final-state equivalence.

decisions.mapping_basis: Frozen S4 storage-owner and delegate-call review treats cbETH as an upgradeable fungible-token namespace. The native family preserves balances/allowances/supply-style token dependencies across the proxy storage context; unsupported implementation selectors remain explicit opaque actions.
decisions.semantic_notes: The proxy owner is the native instance namespace; implementation DELEGATECALL frames inherit that storage namespace.

decisions.mapping_basis: Frozen S4 direct activity is standard fungible-token transfer behavior. cw20-base preserves the reviewed balance/transfer/allowance state classes; unreviewed proxy/implementation selectors remain opaque.
decisions.semantic_notes: No exact EVM storage-layout equivalence is claimed.

decisions.mapping_basis: Frozen S4 activity is approve/balance/transfer-like and is represented by the standard cw20-base balance/allowance dependency classes. Selectors outside the reviewed ERC20-like scope remain opaque.
decisions.semantic_notes: Reuse is scoped to observed fungible-token dependency semantics, not bytecode equivalence.
